text: # Ground truth for app/ml/triage.check_emergency.
# `expect` is yes when the person is describing something about themselves that
# should stop the questionnaire and send them for emergency care
# otherwise. It is a judgement about what the app should DO
# the words appear.
# Two of the "no" categories are the point of this file:
#   negated      "no chest pain" contains the phrase and means the opposite
#   attributed   "my dad had chest pain" is somebody else's symptom
#                usually a person asking for exactly the risk assessment this
#                app offers -- firing the stop sign blocks them from it
# The rest are ordinary complaints. `incidental` ones deliberately contain the
# words of an emergency phrase scattered across an unrelated sentence
# the matcher is order-independent over a bag of stems.
# Lines beginning with # are comments. Written by hand; extend it rather than
# tuning thresholds against it blindly.
